deploy.startCommand: if [ -f '/app/apps/web-admin/server.js' ]; then cd /app/apps/web-admin && node server.js; elif [ -f '/app/server.js' ]; then cd /app && node server.js; elif NEXT_BIN=$(find /app -path '*/node_modules/.bin/next' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1); then cd /app/apps/web-admin && "$NEXT_BIN" start -p ${PORT:-3000} -H 0.0.0.0; else exit 1; fi
